items.title: Tame Dependabot: Group your updates, slow the cadence, keep security fast
items.content:
Dependabot keeps your dependencies current, but its defaults can flood your repository with pull requests. Here's how grouping updates, slowing the cadence, and keeping security fixes fast cut the noise on a Microsoft open source project.

The post Tame Dependabot: Group your updates, slow the cadence, keep security fast appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Dependabot keeps your dependencies current, but its defaults can flood your repository with pull requests. Here's how grouping updates, slowing the cadence, and keeping security fixes fast cut the noise on a Microsoft open source project.
The post Tame Dependabot: Group your updates, slow the cadence, keep security fast appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Bruno Borges

summaries.zh: Dependabot 默认设置会让仓库涌来大量拉取请求。本文介绍了微软一个开源项目的应对方法：对依赖更新进行分组，放慢例行更新的节奏，同时确保安全修复快速合并，从而有效减少干扰和噪音。
summaries.en: Dependabot's default settings often overwhelm repositories with excessive pull requests. This article outlines strategies to reduce that noise in a Microsoft open source project: grouping related updates into fewer pull requests, slowing the overall update cadence, and ensuring security fixes still arrive quickly. These adjustments help maintain dependency freshness without flooding developers.

items.summary: Dependabot 默认设置会让仓库涌来大量拉取请求。本文介绍了微软一个开源项目的应对方法：对依赖更新进行分组，放慢例行更新的节奏，同时确保安全修复快速合并，从而有效减少干扰和噪音。

items.title: The case for a cooldown: Why Dependabot now waits before issuing version updates
items.content:
A new default three-day cooldown delays version update pull requests so maintainers and security researchers can address findings in a release before it gets into your code.

The post The case for a cooldown: Why Dependabot now waits before issuing version updates appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
A new default three-day cooldown delays version update pull requests so maintainers and security researchers can address findings in a release before it gets into your code.
The post The case for a cooldown: Why Dependabot now waits before issuing version updates appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Carlin Cherry

summaries.zh: GitHub 为 Dependabot 引入了默认三天的冷却期。现在，版本更新拉取请求会延迟三天发出，以便维护者和安全研究人员有足够时间处理新发布中发现的潜在问题，避免这些问题直接进入使用者的代码。该调整旨在增强依赖项更新的安全性与可控性。
summaries.en: Dependabot now introduces a default three-day cooldown before creating version update pull requests. This delay allows maintainers and security researchers time to identify and fix issues in a new release before the update is automatically integrated into your code. The change aims to improve stability and security by preventing potentially problematic releases from being rushed into projects.

items.summary: GitHub 为 Dependabot 引入了默认三天的冷却期。现在，版本更新拉取请求会延迟三天发出，以便维护者和安全研究人员有足够时间处理新发布中发现的潜在问题，避免这些问题直接进入使用者的代码。该调整旨在增强依赖项更新的安全性与可控性。

items.title: Copilot vs. raw API access: What are you actually paying for?
items.content:
Copilot now bills usage at listed API rates. Compare direct model access with the coding workflow, policy, and harness work around it.

The post Copilot vs. raw API access: What are you actually paying for? appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Copilot now bills usage at listed API rates. Compare direct model access with the coding workflow, policy, and harness work around it.
The post Copilot vs. raw API access: What are you actually paying for? appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Andrea Griffiths

summaries.zh: GitHub Copilot 现已按公开的 API 费率计费。文章对比了直接调用原始模型 API 与使用 Copilot 的差异，指出用户实际支付的不仅是模型访问成本，还涵盖了围绕编码工作流的集成、策略管控以及连接各类工具的“线束”工作。这意味着 Copilot 的价值在于将模型能力无缝嵌入开发流程，并附带合规与工程化支撑，而非单纯的接口调用。
summaries.en: GitHub Copilot now charges for usage at listed API rates, prompting a comparison with direct model access. The article examines what users actually pay for: not just raw API costs, but also the integrated coding workflow, built-in policy compliance, and the surrounding harness that Copilot provides. It highlights the trade-offs between off-the-shelf model APIs and a managed service that streamlines development and governance.

items.summary: GitHub Copilot 现已按公开的 API 费率计费。文章对比了直接调用原始模型 API 与使用 Copilot 的差异，指出用户实际支付的不仅是模型访问成本，还涵盖了围绕编码工作流的集成、策略管控以及连接各类工具的“线束”工作。这意味着 Copilot 的价值在于将模型能力无缝嵌入开发流程，并附带合规与工程化支撑，而非单纯的接口调用。
